spanish: Y será perdonado a toda congregación de hijos de Israel y al peregrino el peregrinante en medio de ellos, porque a todo el pueblo por error.

findings.issue: Niphal perfect 3ms with conjunction is rendered as future será; the packet marks perfect, so past/resultative remains open.
בְּ smoothed to por; the inadvertence noun is kept and the verbless clause is not filled in.

notes: Recipients, sojourner plus participle, and the verbless כִּי clause stay within the tokens.
